# The As-Received Web

> A dated measurement of what live websites return to an HTTP agent. Edition 01: 19 of 20 hosts, 18 October 2026. No scores, no rankings, raw data included.

- [Edition 01](edition-01.html): the report. Homepages only, no JavaScript, k=1, convenience sample.
- [Data](data.html): tables plus CSV, JSON, MANIFEST and SHA-256 seals.
- [Corrections](corrections.html): how to report a factual error; corrections are printed in the next edition.
- [Landing](index.html): what this is and what it refuses to claim.
